description: This file implements the hardware layer for position sensor inputs, including trigger input handling, callbacks for ICU (Input Capture Unit) events, and related configuration functions for a vehicle engine control system.

methods.name: cam_icu_width_callback
methods.description: Callback function invoked upon ICU width event for camera sensor, increments VVT rise counter and handles VVT cam signal.

methods.name: cam_icu_period_callback
methods.description: Callback function invoked upon ICU period event for camera sensor, increments VVT fall counter and handles VVT cam signal.

methods.name: shaft_icu_width_callback
methods.description: Interrupt callback for shaft ICU width events, determines trigger polarity and signals shaft events.

methods.name: shaft_icu_period_callback
methods.description: Interrupt callback for shaft ICU period events, determines trigger polarity and signals shaft events.

methods.name: turnOnTriggerInputPin
methods.description: Configures and enables ICU input capture for a specified hardware pin and callback configuration.

methods.name: turnOffTriggerInputPin
methods.description: Disables ICU input capture and associated notifications for the specified hardware pin.

methods.name: rememberPrimaryChannel
methods.description: Saves the current primary trigger input capture driver reference.

methods.name: turnOnTriggerInputPins
methods.description: Initializes trigger input pins with given logger, turning on the necessary hardware inputs.

methods.name: stopTriggerInputPins
methods.description: Turns off all trigger input pins that have changed in configuration.

methods.name: applyNewTriggerInputPins
methods.description: Applies new trigger input configurations, turning on or off pins as needed, and sets the primary channel.
